variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: `var` creates mutable variables, `let` creates immutable bindings.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.code:
var a: Int = 1
var b: Float64 = 2.0
var c: Bool = True
var d: String = "hello"
data_types.notes: Mojo builds on Python with strong typing capabilities.

operators.title: Operators
operators.code:
var z = x + y
var b = x > y

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: For loops are identical to Python.

functions.title: Functions
functions.code:
fn add(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int:
    return a + b
functions.notes: `fn` creates strictly-typed Mojo functions, while `def` creates Python-like dynamic functions.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.code:
from collections import List
var arr = List[Int](1, 2, 3)
arrays.notes: Dynamic arrays are provided by `List` in the standard library.

maps.title: Maps
maps.notes: Dictionaries are strictly typed when using `Dict`.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.code:
# Single-line comment in Mojo

"""
Multi-line documentation block.
Provides docstrings for functions and modules.
"""

def add(a, b):
    """Return sum of a and b."""
    return a + b
comments.notes: Mojo uses # for line comments and triple quotes for multi-line documentation strings.

numbers.title: Numbers & Numerics
numbers.notes: Mojo supports arbitrary-precision or native integers, IEEE floats, and numeric literal prefixes (0x, 0b).

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.code:
is_active = True
has_failed = False

if is_active and not has_failed:
    print("Active")
booleans.notes: Mojo represents boolean values with logical and, or, and not operators.

type_casting.title: Type Casting & Conversion
type_casting.code:
num_str = "42"
n = int(num_str)
f = float(n)
s = str(f)
type_casting.notes: Mojo uses explicit conversion functions or operators to transform types between primitives.

strings.title: Strings & Escapes
strings.code:
s1 = "Double-quoted string"
s2 = 'Single-quoted string'
raw = r"C:\new_folder\raw.txt"
multi = """Line 1
Line 2"""
strings.notes: Mojo supports single, double, and raw string literals that ignore escape characters.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.code:
name = "Alice"
score = 95
msg = f"User {name} scored {score:.1f}"
print(msg)
string_formatting.notes: Mojo uses f-string interpolation or format specifiers for embedded expression formatting.

pattern_matching.title: Pattern Matching
pattern_matching.code:
match val:
    case 1:
        print("One")
    case 2 | 3:
        print("Two or Three")
    case _:
        print("Default")
pattern_matching.notes: Mojo provides structural pattern matching with match/case or case-of expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Slices
range.code:
r = range(1, 10, 2)
sub = nums[1:5]
rev = nums[::-1]
range.notes: Mojo provides built-in range generation and slicing syntax with interval boundaries.

iterators.title: Iterators & Generators
iterators.notes: Mojo uses generator functions or iterators with the yield keyword for lazy element production.

oop_classes.title: Classes & OOP
oop_classes.notes: Mojo supports object-oriented paradigms with methods, constructors, and encapsulation.

lists.title: Lists & Dynamic Arrays
lists.notes: Mojo provides mutable dynamic lists/sequences with append, insert, and indexing operations.

tuples.title: Tuples & Records
tuples.notes: Mojo provides immutable ordered tuples supporting unpack destructuring.

sets.title: Sets & Collections
sets.notes: Mojo provides unique element set collections with membership tests and mathematical set operations.

modules_import.title: Modules & Imports
modules_import.code:
import math
from math import sqrt, pi
import os.path as path
modules_import.notes: Mojo manages code organization via modules and selective import statements.
